scope: 42 previously identified candidates only; 2 dry-run companions recorded separately

categoryDefinitions.A_legacy_catalog_workflow: Old catalog-only orchestration eligible for YAML retirement in the replacement. Retain shared calculation/encyclopedia helpers and all protected data; this is not permission to execute its reset or delete scripts transitively.
categoryDefinitions.B_shared_release_responsibilities: Retired release workflow mixes catalogue work, private encyclopedia release binding and full-site ingress. Separate these responsibilities and preserve acceptance/rollback gates before retirement.
categoryDefinitions.C_blocked_at_audited_revision: Old workflow whose current source/date guard prevents the catalog write path. This is not literal if:false and not proof for an older run SHA or another checkout ref.

deletionPreconditions: Confirm targeted runs/jobs are terminal; a YAML deletion does not cancel already assigned work.
Retire reusable callers and scripted dispatchers as a group, or remove their incoming invocation first.
Update affected legacy contract tests and workflow_run name references in the replacement; preserve CI, performance and release acceptance gates.
Do not delete calculation/identity/encyclopedia helpers just because these retired workflows import them.
Do not execute any old reset/cleanup as the deletion mechanism. No data deletion is authorized by this map.
reverseReferenceLimits: Exact reusable edges and workflow_run names come from all 644 audited workflow definitions. Literal filename references were searched only for these 44 targets in .github, scripts, tests, docs/operations and package.json, excluding generated audit JSON. This does not prove the absence of constructed external callers.

reset_catalog.description: Delete the current catalog before collection

workflows.whyNotC: Optional reset can execute before downstream V3 validation. The raw-policy guard depends on actual storage and is not a source-proven permanent blocker.
workflows.checkpointPrefixOverlap: Object listObjects normalizes the supplied prefix without appending a slash and passes it unchanged to the S3 prefix query. Thus deletePrefix("catalog") can also select catalog-rebuild/...; it is not a filesystem-directory boundary. A checkpoint namespace not beginning with catalog avoids this specific legacy reset prefix, but does not prove protection against every other cleaner.
